title: Basic Study of Combination Therapy Based on APCC-induced FVllI Activation in Hemophilia A Patients With Inhibitors
brief_summary: Using whole blood samples and plasma samples obtained from some hemophilia A patients with inhibitors, the investigators will perform the coagulation assessment in the co-presence of aPCC and factor VIII by comprehensive coagulation assays and flow chamber analysis under blood flow conditions.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients with hemophilia A with inhibitors (Inhibitor titer; \>0.5 Bethesda U/ml)
* Patients with agreement consents with the patients signatures

Exclusion Criteria:

* Patients that do not fill the conditions described above
study_population: We guess that there are approximately 200-300 hemophilia A patients with inhibitors in our country. We have approximately 20 out-patients in our hospital. Based on this information, we set up the patients subjects (n=10).
